subject: POC prompt set & eval dataset - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liz Monroe <liz@acmehealth.com>, Tom Gardner <tom.gardner@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC prompt set & eval dataset - next steps

Hi Liz / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can kick off the POC dataset collection and evaluation plan: 

Recap from call:
- Goal: 4-week POC to validate Redwood inference on two core flows (clinical summarization and triage routing) against Acme’s existing pipeline.
- Success criteria (provisional): >= 90% accuracy on key extractive fields in summarization; median latency < 250ms for 512-token generation in our Dedicated config; no PII leakage in outputs.
- Data ask: representative prompt set + 200 historical logs (anonymized) per flow; labeled examples where possible for eval.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) You to share an initial prompt set and sample logs (anonymized). See attached sample CSV (acme_prompt_samples.csv) and our success-criteria doc (poc-success-criteria.docx).
2) Aditya will validate data formats and share the upload instructions and secure S3 endpoint.
3) We’ll run a quick smoke evaluation within 72 hours of receiving the samples and share a preliminary report.
4) Agree on owners and timeline for the 4-week trial (proposal below).

Suggested timeline:
- Jul 25–28: dataset handoff and format validation
- Jul 29–Aug 4: baseline eval + tuning pass
- Aug 5–Aug 22: iterative runs and joint QA
- Week of Aug 24: POC wrap, metrics review, and next steps

Ownership:
- Acme: provide sample prompts/logs, anonymize PII, point of contact for clarifying examples (Liz).
- Redwood: ingestion, eval harness, preliminary tuning, and report (Marissa + Aditya).

Request: Can you share the sample CSV or a secure link to the logs by EOD Jul 28? If there are any compliance constraints (S3 restrictions, DLP requirements), flag them and we’ll route to our security team.

Appreciate it — looking forward to moving quickly.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: acme_prompt_samples.csv, poc-success-criteria.docx

Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC prompt set & eval dataset - next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. I’ve attached a small slice of our prompt logs (anonymized) and a CSV with ~50 prompts per flow to start — see link below (I’m attaching the CSV here as "acme_prompt_samples.csv"). We’ll work to get the full 200 logs per flow by Jul 28 but wanted to get you something to unblock the smoke run.

Notes:
- We removed direct patient identifiers but left contextual fields (age range, encounter type). Let us know if we need to strip more.
- We haven’t provided labels for all examples yet; we’ll prioritize 50 labeled examples for the summarization flow.
- Security: we can upload to your secure S3 bucket or share via an encrypted Drive link; preference is S3.

Drive link (temporary): https://acmehealth.share/drive/POC-samples

Liz
Senior Product Manager, Clinical AI | Acme Health
liz@acmehealth.com

Liz — thanks for sending the initial set. A couple quick technical notes to make ingestion faster: 

1) Preferred CSV format: UTF-8, header row with columns: flow, prompt_id, prompt_text, metadata_json (if available), label (optional). If you can't provide metadata_json, separate columns for encounter_type and age_bucket are fine.
2) For logs: gzip the exports and keep each flow in a separate file (e.g., summarization_logs_2026-07.gz).
3) S3 upload: We can provision a pre-signed S3 bucket for Acme. Marissa — I'll send the presigned-upload instructions and a short checklist for PII checks by EOD.

Ownership confirmation: 
- Ingestion + validation: Aditya (redwood)
- Eval harness + report: Marissa (redwood)
- Label clarifications: Liz / Samir (acme)

We’ll run a smoke eval within 48–72 hours of the sample arriving. If the sample looks clean, we’ll share a preliminary metrics snapshot and any immediate tuning suggestions.

Thanks — Aditya
Principal ML Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Marissa / Aditya —

All good on our side. We’ll upload the full 200 logs per flow to the presigned S3 link by EOD Jul 28. Liz will own the labeled set (we expect 50 labeled examples for the summarization flow in the first batch).

Two quick asks from procurement/security: 
- Can Redwood sign the data processing addendum (DPA) we sent last week? It’s a short one and required before we put any production-ish data in your bucket.
- Can you confirm retention for POC artifacts (we’d like 30 days then auto-delete unless we agree otherwise).

If you can confirm those two items we’ll proceed with the upload. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Tom
Director, Platform Integrations | Acme Health
